name: Town Gates, Inner Bailey
desc1: This is the entryway to the city of Silvermere. It is a strategic
desc2: passage leading up to the town gates to the west. Holes in the twenty
desc3: foot stone ceiling allow soldiers to drop large stones, or pour
desc4: cauldrons of boiling oil down of foes assaulting the gates. Guards
desc5: stand at the ready here to take a toll for entering the city.
